Description: LDO regulator active IC is misnamed 'J_PWR' (connector prefix). Schematic symbol has 3 pins (1:VIN, 2:GND, 3:VOUT), but physical SOT-23-5 package has 5 pins (1:VIN, 2:GND, 3:EN, 4:NC, 5:VOUT). Pin 3 is connected to /3V3 rail, leaving EN tied to unpowered rail and actual VOUT (pin 5) completely floating! LDO will output 0V.
Evidence: kicad-cli sch export netlist shows J_PWR with pins 1, 2, 3; footprint J_PWR.kicad_mod has 5 pads. AP2112K datasheet defines pin 3 as EN, pin 5 as VOUT.
ProposedCorrection: Create dedicated KiCad symbol U4 (AP2112K-3.3TRG1) with all 5 pins: Pin 1=VIN (VBAT_SW), Pin 2=GND, Pin 3=EN (tied to VIN/VBAT_SW), Pin 4=NC, Pin 5=VOUT (3V3). Rename reference designator to U4 in schematic and BOM.
RequiredVerification: Schematic netlist re-export and pin-level connectivity test.

AffectedComponent_Net: Net 3V3, GND, VBAT, USB_VBUS, USB_DM_CORE, USB_DP_CORE, UART_RX, UART_TX
Description: Main PCB in Client Delivery package contains 1,338 DRC violations, including 199 track crossings and 199 shorting items. Net 3V3 is shorted to GND, VBAT is shorted to GND, VBUS (5V) is shorted to VBAT (3.7V LiPo), and USB D+/D- are shorted together. Board is non-functional and poses immediate fire/destruction hazard.
Evidence: Fresh KiCad 10.0.7 CLI pcb drc execution exited with code 5; output reports 199 shorting_items, 199 tracks_crossing, 499 clearance violations in Main_SmartPen_ClientDelivery_drc.json.
ProposedCorrection: Reject Client Delivery SmartPen.kicad_pcb as corrupted. Use RevF_Working layout as baseline or perform clean re-route respecting 0.127mm clearance rules and ground plane integrity.
RequiredVerification: Fresh kicad-cli pcb drc reporting 0 shorting_items, 0 tracks_crossing, 0 clearance errors.

Description: Charger PROG resistor R9 is 3.3 kOhm, setting charge current to 303 mA. If a 130-150 mAh LiPo cell is installed (mandated by 15-16 mm barrel OD constraint), charge rate is 2.0C - 2.33C. Standard LiPo cells specify 0.5C-1.0C maximum. High risk of severe cell swelling, overheating, and thermal runaway in an enclosed barrel.
Evidence: MCP73831 datasheet equation Ireg = 1000 / Rprog = 1000 / 3300 = 303 mA. Battery capacity conflict in project documents (130-150 mAh vs 300 mAh).
ProposedCorrection: Validate actual physical battery capacity. Recalculate R9: for 130-150 mAh cell, set R9 to 10 kOhm (100 mA, 0.67C-0.77C) or 6.8 kOhm (147 mA, ~1.0C max).
RequiredVerification: Charge current calculation test and manufacturer cell datasheet verification.

AffectedComponent_Net: Claimed DMG2305UX, Claimed MBR0520L, Net /USB_VBUS, Net /VBAT, Net /VBAT_SW
Description: Historical documentation claims a dynamic power-path switch using DMG2305UX and MBR0520L. Physical inspection proves these parts do not exist in schematic or BOM. D3 is an inductive flyback diode for the motor, not a power-path diode. System load sits in parallel with LiPo during charging, which violates MCP73831 C/10 termination.
Evidence: SmartPen.kicad_sch netlist and BOM contain no DMG2305UX or MBR0520L. VBUS connects only to charger U2.4.
ProposedCorrection: Implement true dynamic power-path circuit using a P-MOSFET (e.g. DMG2305UX) and Schottky diode (or dedicated power-path IC like TPS2113A/MCP73871) or formalize parallel battery charging topology with client approval.
RequiredVerification: Schematic review and power-path simulation under USB plugged/unplugged transitions.

Description: Power slide switch SW3 is situated between VBAT and VBAT_SW. When SW3 is in OFF position, VBAT_SW is disconnected. Because USB 5V does not feed the LDO input, plugging in USB does not power the pen if SW3 is OFF. Furthermore, if battery is discharged below LDO dropout (<3.0V), pen cannot boot from USB alone.
Evidence: SmartPen.kicad_sch wiring: J_PWR pin 1 is connected only to VBAT_SW; USB_VBUS does not connect to J_PWR.
ProposedCorrection: Route diode-OR or power-path output to feed LDO input so USB VBUS can power the system regardless of battery state.
RequiredVerification: Verify system rail 3V3 is 3.3V when USB is attached with battery disconnected or SW3 OFF.
